talk.jaymoskingdoms.shipwright.idle: Nothing on the slip just now. When the realm wants a ship, I'll lay her down right there by the pier.
That's %1$s's whaler on the slip, the deepest hull I build. About %2$s%% of her is in. Timber's always short.
%1$s's new warship. About %2$s%% of her is in, and she'll keep the pirates off this harbour soon enough.
Another for %1$s's squadron. About %2$s%% of her is in. The flagship won't sail alone much longer.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shipwright.ready.con: She's all in. A word over her bow and she goes to join the flagship.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shipwright.ready.wha: She's all in. A word over her bow and she goes in the water.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shipwright.ready.war: She's all in. A word over her bow and she goes in the water.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shipwright.timber: Lend a hand (give him your planks and logs)
talk.jaymoskingdoms.shipwright.thanks: Good timber. That'll put her in the water sooner. I won't forget it, and nor will the realm.
